newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse bucks Euro trend with record close.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse bucks Euro trend with record close.

text.p: The Brussels bourse bucked widespread decline in Europe on Thursday to clock up a closing gain of 0.4 percent in fairly active trading.
"Brussels saw good activity compared with other western European markets," KB Securities analyst Peter Hofman said.
The Bel-20 index of blue chips .BFX ended 10.29 points higher at 2,541.40, a closing high after earlier setting an intra-day high of 2,562.94.
Chemical and drug company UCB was again a star performer, up 2,200 francs at 148,500.
The stock had earlier set an intra-day high of 153,000 francs. Traders estimated that UCB alone accounted for some 12 percent of the turnover by value in Bel-20 issues.
In total 13 of the Bel-20 companies rose on Thursday, while six declined and one ended unchanged.
Union Miniere and Generale Bank lost 140 and 75 francs respectively, while CBR fell 40 francs, SGB slipped five francs, Barco dropped 40 francs and Electrabel fell 10 francs.
Among the climbers PetroFina, up 2.4 percent to 14,175 francs and CMB, up 2.2 percent to 2,610 francs, starred.
